opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

amount.raw: Grants up to £200 (A), up to £500/£750 (B), up to £300 (C)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate, Master’s, PhD student members and postdoctoral members (within six years of PhD viva) for Scheme A; PhD students and postdocs (within six years) for Schemes B & C; UK‑based members for overseas conferences.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance at Genetics Society meetings, other genetics conferences, and virtual conferences with travel, accommodation, and registration costs.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or attending a UK‑based course; members must have at least one year of membership (except students).
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,200 to attend short training courses or collaborative lab visits for genetics/genomics techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Supports travel and accommodation for field‑based genetics research projects that aim for publication in the journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: One‑off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: Sponsorship levels from a few hundred pounds up to several thousand pounds (typically £1,000–£2,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Genetics Society may apply at any time to sponsor genetics‑themed meetings held in or linked to the UK.
opportunities.summary: Provides financial support for organising one‑off genetics meetings, including possible Carer’s Awards for attendees.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Supports public engagement activities (in‑person or virtual) related to genetics, covering travel and material costs.
